title: All The Stage Is An Alleyway

contact_edits.before: There is something pat and predictable about this second relationship; its participants are reduced to playing chorus to the central drama, rather than being co-equal with it. Nor, in this production at least, do the quartet's rare moments of peaceful co-existence function as the points of rest for which they were presumably intended. There are holes in the pattern. But the main threads are very strong. Very little has changed in our cities since the play was written, and the production doesn't have to strain very hard to remind us of that. But even if it had, the story of Alan and Theresa, and even the Crackwalker himself, would still strike home. - The Crackwalker runs until Oct. 11. For tickets and information, call 416-504-7529.
